title: Home Mortgage Loans: Forbearance Month Allowances and Qualifying Hardships
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Forbearance Month Allowances and Qualifying Hardships

A forbearance plan on Home Mortgage Loans suspends or reduces payments for a limited time. Each program sets how long a first plan may run, how many forbearance months a loan may accumulate across its whole life, and which kinds of hardship qualify.

## Month allowances

| Program | Longest first plan (months) | Lifetime total of all plans (months) |
|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6 | 12 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6 | 12 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 12 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 12 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 3 | 12 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 6 |

## Qualifying hardships

| Hardship type | FHA | VA | Conventional 30-Year | Conventional 15-Year | 7/6 SOFR ARM | Jumbo |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| involuntary job loss | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies |
| medical | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies |
| natural disaster | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies |
| death of a co-borrower | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies |
| military deployment | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | qualifies | not listed |

In the second table the column headings abbreviate the program names: FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage and Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage.

## Reading the allowances

**Which programs allow the longest first plan?** The FHA and VA programs, at 6 months each; the rest allow 3.

**Where is the lifetime total smaller?** Only in the jumbo program, which allows 6 months in all instead of 12.

**Is military deployment a qualifying hardship everywhere?** It qualifies in five programs; the jumbo program's list does not include it.
